key_points.evidence_quote: Four components sit left of the double rule; five dark-to-light profiles sit right
key_points.point_text: Legend and layout: four components left of the double rule, five dark-to-light profiles right
key_points.reasoning: Component/profile split and dark-to-light ordering captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: Rows fall in four blocks: present in both, psychopath only, sociopath only, neither
key_points.point_text: Rows ordered in four blocks by the dark-profile contrast

key_points.evidence_quote: Cognitive empathy means accurate modeling, boundary, and control; it survives in manipulators; Sympathy earns only partial on modeling
key_points.point_text: Cognitive profile (modeling, boundary, control, manipulators) with sympathy's partial-modeling caveat
key_points.reasoning: All four cognitive full marks plus the pity-misreads rationale are present.

key_points.evidence_quote: The psychopath column is essentially the cognitive-empathy column standing alone; only control is psychopath-only
key_points.point_text: Psychopath as cognitive-alone; cold instrumental control as its one distinguishing possession
key_points.reasoning: Both the standing-alone identity and the control-only asymmetry are captured with cell-level backup.

key_points.evidence_quote: Affective empathy means sharing emotion, with contagion, burnout, and vividness bias; lacks boundary; only partial on caring
key_points.point_text: Affective profile (sharing, contagion/burnout, bias) with boundary lack and care-partial caveats
key_points.reasoning: Full pattern plus both structural caveats (notes 5 and 2) present.

key_points.evidence_quote: The sociopath resembles affective empathy plus sympathy clamped to an in-group, unregulated; affective rows owned by sociopath
key_points.point_text: Sociopath as clamped in-group affect/sympathy without regulation, holding the affective cluster
key_points.reasoning: Identity plus the five-row ownership evidence both present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Compassion alone combines caring, motivation to help, wide scope, and sustainability; Bloom and Singer case is a position, not a consensus
key_points.point_text: Compassion profile (caring, motivation, scope, sustainability) with the Bloom/Singer position-not-consensus caveat
key_points.reasoning: All four compassion full marks plus the contested-status caveat present.

key_points.evidence_quote: The empath maximizes affect unregulated, so it is not the moral ideal; lights up sharing, contagion, bias but fails boundary, scope, scalability
key_points.point_text: Empath as maxed unregulated affect, explicitly not the moral ideal (fails boundary, scope, scale)
key_points.reasoning: The anti-ideal verdict with its six-cell evidence pattern is fully present.

key_points.evidence_quote: The altruist embodies compassion and the Light Triad: Kantianism, Humanism, Faith in Humanity
key_points.point_text: Altruist as embodied compassion matching the Light Triad
key_points.reasoning: Identity plus all three Triad members present.

key_points.evidence_quote: The integrated ideal alone scores well across every block, opposing both dark profiles
key_points.point_text: Integrated ideal as the only well-rounded column, opposite of both dark profiles
key_points.reasoning: The 'only' scope and the double-opposition verdict are present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Kantianism inverts the manipulators row; only Faith in Humanity adds a new dimension
key_points.point_text: Light Triad restatement analysis: Kantianism inverts manipulators, only Faith adds a new dimension
key_points.reasoning: Both halves of the restatement analysis present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Etiology stays out: causal origin is not a response shape
key_points.point_text: Etiology deliberately excluded (cause versus response shape)

key_points.evidence_quote: Psychopath and sociopath are not formal diagnoses; both fall under antisocial personality disorder
key_points.point_text: Clinical caveat: ideal types, not diagnoses, both under ASPD

key_points.evidence_quote: Terminology varies; empathic concern and pop-psych sympathy differ from table usage
